properties.name: view_mode
properties.comment: Icons or details. An undeclared mode throws std::invalid_argument; a change keeps the first visible item in view and ends a header interaction. A view, so the write can keep the first visible item.
hand: a view onto view_mode_; write_view converts top_row across the column count and cancels header interaction

properties.name: selected_id
properties.comment: The primary selected item's stable ID, or empty; a view over the selection (G2). A write selects that item alone, or clears the selection, and raises selection_changed; an ID not in the model throws std::out_of_range. set_selected_ids sets several.
hand: a view onto the selection: write_view applies a one-item (or empty) selection

properties.name: selection_mode
properties.comment: Whether one item or several may be selected. Turning on single selection keeps only the primary item.
hand: written trims a multiple selection to the primary item under single selection

properties.name: icon_cell_size
properties.comment: The icon mode's cell size, 86 by 78 through 512 by 512 (std::invalid_argument otherwise).
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("ObjectView icon cell must be 86x78 through 512x512");

properties.name: details_row_height
properties.comment: The details mode's row height, 20 through 256 (std::invalid_argument otherwise).
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("ObjectView details row height must be 20 through 256");

properties.name: show_secondary_text
properties.comment: Whether icon cells show each item's secondary text under its name.

properties.name: font
properties.comment: The items' font (Font). Throws std::invalid_argument for an invalid FontSpec; any write marks the font as set from code.
prepare: if (!valid_font_spec(incoming)) throw std::invalid_argument("ObjectView font is invalid");

properties.name: image_list
properties.comment: The images that the items' image keys name; a list must be alive and belong to this view's Window (std::invalid_argument otherwise). A change follows the new list's changes.
hand: prepare_write: a live list of the own Window; written: resubscribe to the list's changes

properties.name: details_sort
properties.comment: The accepted sort indicator: a sortable column and a direction, or an empty column for none; a view, since set_details_model carries or clears it. Sorting the items is the application's work (sort_requested). An unknown or unsortable column or an undeclared direction throws std::invalid_argument.
hand: a view onto details_sort_, which set_details_model carries or clears; write_view validates and drops the text cache

not_properties.name: items
not_properties.reason: the model is replaced whole and validated as a set; collections stay methods

not_properties.name: selected_ids
not_properties.reason: derived selection with a primary ID (G2); stays a method

not_properties.name: top_row
not_properties.reason: scroll state clamped by layout: the read differs from the write

not_properties.name: horizontal_offset
not_properties.reason: scroll state clamped by layout: the read differs from the write
